sources.title: GitHub - harshvardhansgupta/OCR_Model: Our AI model is designed to ...
sources.snippet: Our AI model is designed to predict text from images of handwritten words. It combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for enhanced accuracy. Trained on the IAM Handwriting Word Database from Kaggle, the model achieves a character-level accuracy of 89.4124% and a word-level accuracy of 70.8018% - harshvardhansgupta/OCR_Model

sources.title: AI Handwriting Recognition - GitHub
sources.snippet: AI-powered Handwriting Recognition system that converts handwritten text into digital text. Built using Flask, OpenCV, Pytesseract, and React.js, this project enables users to upload images of handwritten notes and extract the text using Optical Character Recognition (OCR).
